sources.entry: PmWiki - Wiki-based system for collaborative creation and maintenance of websites. GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.name: PmWiki
summary.one_liner: PmWiki is a wiki-based system for collaboratively creating and maintaining websites, written in PHP and released under GPL-3.0.
use_cases: Build a collaborative website edited by multiple users
Maintain a team documentation or knowledge base
Extend a wiki with cookbook recipes and skins
Create multilingual wiki sites with language packs
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PmWiki as a wiki-based system for collaborative creation and maintenance of websites. It distributes core downloads, language packs, a cookbook of recipes and skins, and a development zip. Release notes list features such as page variables, markup expressions, visible anchors, uploads with a Dropzone progress bar, and access-protected wiki groups. Recent versions (2.7.x) moved much core functionality away from PHP eval() to callback functions. The page also lists a change log and an archive of older notes.
notable: Written in PHP and licensed GPL-3.0
Extensible through cookbook recipes, skins and page variables
Recent 2.7.x releases reduced reliance on PHP eval() and added a temporary per-visitor page store for wikis without a config file
Includes multilingual support through installable language packs
caveats: The website was temporarily offline at the time of capture while the PHP installation was upgraded
Versions 2.0.0 to 2.7.4 on Windows servers were vulnerable to a disclosure bug fixed in 2.7.5, so upgrading is needed
Some local customizations of page variables, conditions, and markup expressions may need updating to the new API
